label: CROSS_VENUE_SPEC_LITERAL_REPLICATION_AND_POOLED_SYNTHESIS
provenance_caveat: Real OKX / Binance UM exchange data, non-synthetic, CROSS-VENUE vs the Hyperliquid spec; NOT Hyperliquid performance evidence and must never be relabelled as such. Multi-year window 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z..2026-09-28T23:00:00Z (32808 hourly bars/symbol). Performance evidence only when produced by the full decision-grade battery under this prereg.
objective: Run the C19-adjudicated spec-faithful entry rule (SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN) on both independent multi-year cross-venue archives (OKX, Binance UM) with the full dependence-aware battery, then issue one cross-venue verdict plus a pooled venue-blocked synthesis. This closes the gap that all prior cross-venue evidence used the canonical same-bar reading while C19 adjudicated spec-literal as faithful.
binding_task: C19-T1 adjudicated SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN as the spec-faithful reading. The native verdict under that reading is NO_GO. C20 tests whether that verdict replicates out-of-sample across two independent venues and 3.4 years, or diverges. Either outcome is decision-relevant and must be reported honestly.

hypothesis.description: Under the C19-adjudicated spec-faithful entry rule, the crash-rebound strategy's cross-venue multi-year edge is measured on two independent venues and pooled with venue-blocked dependence-aware inference.
hypothesis.selection_rule: Fixed by this prereg; no config switching after results.

required_artifacts.handoff: HANDOFF.md must reference C20-T1 and verify_c20_focus_campaign.py

inference_plan.power: Minimum heavy-compute floor: 100 permutation draws and 100 placebo subsets per venue; target 20000 bootstrap/permutation draws and 2000 placebo subsets. GO requires >=10 trades, >=5 episodes, >=5 distinct crash days, bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0, permutation p<0.05, placebo p_ge_canonical<0.05, and a positive spot leg. If unmet, verdict must be UNDERPOWERED or NO_GO with a quantified power curve.

decision_rules.go: GO only if all hold in the pooled synthesis: episode-block bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0 with positive spot leg, permutation p < 0.05, placebo p_ge_canonical < 0.05, and effective N >= 10 trades / 5 episodes / 5 crash days.
no_go: pooled CI95 spans 0 for spot and total
positive total entirely hedge/rebound-masked with non-positive spot
spec-literal reading is negative in both venues (corroborates C19 NO_GO)
underpowered: Effective sample below floor; label UNDERPOWERED/FRAGILE_NOT_DECISION_GRADE
Missing seed/SHA binding or compute predating this prereg

guardrails: No cross-venue relabeling as Hyperliquid-native evidence.
No synthetic gap-fill presented as verified.
No spec relaxation to manufacture a GO; SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN is the fixed reading.
No inference-only churn on exhausted C14 native data.
No silent change to the canonical baseline; the spec-literal flag is opt-in and default false.
C20 is executable on already-verified real archives; acquisition stays closed.
